governance_note: Define controllable variables, units, bounds, and relationship to real decision authority.
Document what is minimized or maximized and whether the objective is a valid proxy for the system goal.
Document equality, inequality, feasibility, capacity, safety, policy, and ethical constraints.
Report gradient expression, update rule, step size, and final gradient norm.
Report Hessian structure, eigenvalue or singular-value review, convexity, and conditioning.
Document solver method, stopping rules, objective history, and convergence status.
Test objective weights, constraints, data perturbations, regularization strength, and parameter uncertainty.
Present the optimum as a model result under assumptions, not automatic policy, causality, or truth.
